positive_cases.name: primitive_object_constructors
positive_cases.expected: primitive Sifr values are explicitly copied into Python Object handles

positive_cases.name: primitive_extractors
positive_cases.expected: Python primitive objects convert explicitly to matching Sifr values

positive_cases.name: fixed_width_extractors
positive_cases.expected: Python integers convert to fixed-width Sifr integers only when in range

positive_cases.name: explicit_container_constructors
positive_cases.expected: Sifr values must be explicitly converted to Object handles before Python containers or record dictionaries are constructed

positive_cases.name: explicit_typed_container_copies
positive_cases.expected: Python lists, tuples, dictionaries, and record fields are copied only through explicit typed conversion APIs

non_goals: Deep list, tuple, dict, and record conversions are never performed implicitly by primitive constructors or Python call arguments.
Generic py.to[T] syntax remains future sugar over explicit typed conversion APIs until HIR lowering preserves explicit type arguments for intrinsics.
